channel.title: Irony vs. Satyr — new on the shelf
channel.description: Bottles as they arrive at Soukenicka 1756.

item.title: Espadin Mezcal
item.description: Roasted in a stone pit, so the smoke is a method, not a flavouring. 700 ml, 45.0%, 1 450 CZK.

item.title: Alpine Amaro
item.description: Root, mint and bitterness. Drink it after everything else has failed. 700 ml, 30.0%, 780 CZK.

item.title: Maraschino Liqueur
item.description: Marasca cherry with the stones in. Nothing like the syrup of the same name. 500 ml, 32.0%, 720 CZK.

item.title: London Dry Gin
item.description: Juniper-forward and unambiguous. The gin a Martini was written for. 700 ml, 43.0%, 690 CZK.

item.title: Orange Curacao
item.description: Bitter orange in brandy. The unglamorous third of a Sidecar. 700 ml, 40.0%, 640 CZK.

item.title: Rhum Agricole Blanc
item.description: Pressed cane juice, never molasses. Grassy and faintly saline. 700 ml, 50.0%, 1 150 CZK.

item.title: Blanco Tequila
item.description: Unaged, additive-free, and tasting of the plant rather than the barrel. 700 ml, 40.0%, 1 250 CZK.

item.title: Sweet Vermouth
item.description: Keep it in the fridge. Yes, really - it is wine, and it dies in a cupboard. 750 ml, 16.5%, 490 CZK.

item.title: Single Malt, 10 Years
item.description: Orchard fruit, a little malt sweetness, no smoke to argue with. 700 ml, 43.0%, 1 290 CZK.

item.title: Reposado Tequila
item.description: Eight months in oak. Softer, and it stops fighting the glass. 700 ml, 40.0%, 1 490 CZK.

item.title: Dry Vermouth
item.description: Alpine and bone-dry. The half of a Martini nobody credits. 750 ml, 18.0%, 520 CZK.

item.title: Creme de Cassis
item.description: Blackcurrant, thick and dark. One bar spoon changes a whole drink. 500 ml, 20.0%, 560 CZK.

item.title: Straight Rye
item.description: Dry, peppery, and the reason a Manhattan has a spine. 700 ml, 50.0%, 1 190 CZK.

item.title: Aged Rum, 8 Years
item.description: Tropical ageing does in eight years what Scotland needs twenty for. 700 ml, 43.0%, 990 CZK.

item.title: Small Batch Bourbon
item.description: Corn-sweet and vanilla-heavy, with enough oak to stop it being a dessert. 700 ml, 45.0%, 1 090 CZK.

item.title: Bitter Aperitivo
item.description: Rhubarb and gentian, coloured somewhere between sunset and a warning. 700 ml, 25.0%, 610 CZK.

item.title: Navy Strength Gin
item.description: Overproof, so it survives contact with citrus and ice without going quiet. 700 ml, 57.0%, 990 CZK.

item.title: Overproof White Rum
item.description: Funky, high-ester and unreasonable. Built for tiki and for float. 700 ml, 63.0%, 850 CZK.

item.title: Barrel-Rested Gin
item.description: Six months in oak. Somewhere between a gin and a young whisky, and honest about it. 500 ml, 46.0%, 1 150 CZK.

item.title: Peated Single Malt
item.description: Coastal and medicinal. Divides a room faster than politics. 700 ml, 46.0%, 1 690 CZK.
